name: Ascetic
body:
You have honed your mind to gain control over your body.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 12, Iron Will.

Benefit(s): You are strong of mind and body and are able to push your needs back in your mind. You gain a +1 bonus to Fortitude and Will saves. Additionally, you require half the amount of food, water, and sleep than normal people of your ancestry. To prepare or regain spells, you still need to take the requisite time.
